metadata.title: Trusted Identity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for Identity and Access Management, viewed holistically as an institutional trust posture.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Digital Identity technology domain encompassing all identity trust capabilities.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite trust pattern asserting that identities meet institutional requirements for assurance, accountability, and control.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Digital Identity subject to comprehensive trust evaluation.

props.name: threat-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts due to failures anywhere in the identity trust chain.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: End-to-end identity governance and defense-in-depth across the identity lifecycle.

metadata.remarks:
Trusted Identity is a composite pattern expressing the institutional position that identities are authoritative, strongly authenticated, correctly authorized, lifecycle-managed, auditable, and bound to appropriate contexts. This pattern does not introduce new controls or assurances; instead, it aggregates and asserts trust across the constituent identity patterns.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern serves as the enterprise trust statement for identity and is used by SSPPs, architecture reviews, and assurance activities to assert that identity use is acceptable when (and only when) all referenced constituent patterns are realized.

components.title: Identity Core

components.title: Identity Authorization

components.title: Identity Lifecycle

components.title: Identity Federation

components.title: Identity Assurance
components.description: Evaluation and propagation of confidence and assurance in identity claims.

components.title: Identity Logging and Audit
